scripts.build: pnpm run build:runtime && node tooling/run-turbo.mjs build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:fast && pnpm run test:system
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:runtime
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --config vitest.root.config.mts test/integration --passWithNoTests && node tooling/run-turbo.mjs test:integration
scripts.test:qualification: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.root.config.mts test/qualification --passWithNoTests && node tooling/qualification/run-assembled.mjs
scripts.test:runtime: vitest run --config vitest.root.config.mts runtime/test/eodhd.test.ts && python3 -m unittest discover -s runtime/test/python -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config vitest.root.config.mts test/unit && node tooling/run-turbo.mjs test:unit
